C0095485 and C0095558 are cited in the prose but not in cited_claim_ids.","The rationale recommends requesting charts for the sampled low-complexity 99215 claims (URI/UTI) and a cloned-language comparison. The formal next_steps instead ask for a generic larger sample and a re-screen, so the concrete, targeted steps are not in the action list.","The claim that URI, UTI and abdominal pain 'rarely justify high-complexity decision-making' is an unsupported clinical judgment, though it is hedged.","The 6 of 24 'no lab on claim' finding is a weak indicator; the summary acknowledges this but still reads it as possible templating."]}
